Today's drafts continue the Lantern Witch as a series, give the Leviathan a sequel with a realism hook, and try a cute dark-fantasy comedy creature, one post in the 14:30-15:30 slot.

drafts.title: 🕯️ THE LANTERN WITCH, NIGHT TWO
drafts.text:
3 nights until Halloween. She opened the door. 🕯️👇

🕯️ THE LANTERN WITCH, NIGHT TWO 🕯️

She let it in, the candle died,
and something cold slipped in beside.
It wears his coat, it knows her name,
but in its eyes there burns no flame.

drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10-12s. Second 0: the door swings open and the blue candle flame dies in one puff, the frame drops to near black. Then a tall figure in a familiar wet coat steps into moonlight, the witch smiles, and the camera pushes into its face to reveal hollow, flameless eyes. End on her lantern relighting by itself.

drafts.title: 🌊 THE LEVIATHAN RETURNS
drafts.text:
AI slop is everywhere. This one came from the deep. 🌊👇

🌊 THE LEVIATHAN RETURNS 🌊

The fishing boats went still at dawn,
the gulls fell quiet, the tide was gone.
Then from the dark a mountain rose,
with eyes that open, never close.

drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s, photoreal look. Second 0: a glassy grey harbor at dawn where the water suddenly pulls back and boats tilt onto wet sand. Then the sea bulges, a barnacled head the size of a hill breaks the surface, and one enormous eye opens right behind a tiny fisherman. Keep it grounded: real fog, spray, no glow.

drafts.title: 🦇 THE LITTLE GARGOYLE ON NIGHT WATCH
drafts.text:
Cutest guard in the cathedral. Worst at his job. 😅🦇👇

🦇 THE LITTLE GARGOYLE ON NIGHT WATCH 🦇

He swore to guard the bell till light,
then tripped on moonbeams half the night.
He growls at bats, he hides from mice,
but brave? He tried it once. Or twice.

drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 8-10s. Second 0: a tiny stone gargoyle on a gothic ledge sneezes and sends up a puff of dust. Then he puffs out his chest at a passing bat, a mouse appears and he leaps behind a gutter, peeking out with wide eyes. End on him dozing off against the bell as the moon rises. Moody gothic light, cute comedic timing.
